transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in today?

I don’t get any enjoyment out of the things I used to love doing, and I can’t make myself start anything anymore. I used to spend so much of my free time on woodworking and cycling, but now I just can't find the motivation to even try.
Have you had other periods in your life lasting at least two weeks when you felt this same loss of interest and low motivation, or is this the first time it has happened?
No, I've never experienced a period like this before. This is definitely the first time in my life I've felt this level of loss of interest and low motivation.

During this period, have you had any hallucinations, like hearing or seeing things others don’t, or any fixed beliefs that others say aren’t true? Have these symptoms only happened when you were feeling depressed?
No, I haven't had any experiences like that at all. I don't hear or see things that aren't there, and I haven't had any unusual or fixed beliefs.

How much is this depression affecting your daily functioning—for example, are you still able to work, take care of yourself, and manage basic responsibilities, or is it making those things nearly impossible?

It’s making daily life nearly impossible. I've stopped looking for new consulting work, missed paying bills because I just can't face the paperwork, and I keep canceling on my friends and my book club. Even basic things like showering or getting groceries feel like a massive chore that completely drains my energy.
Have you had thoughts that life isn’t worth living, or thoughts of hurting yourself or ending your life? If yes, have you made any plans or taken any steps toward it?

To be honest, I pretty regularly think it wouldn't be so bad if I just didn't wake up in the morning. On a couple of really bad days, I've found myself picturing how I might end things, but I haven't actually made any plans or taken any steps to do it.

Have you ever had a period lasting several days or longer when you felt unusually energetic or euphoric, needed much less sleep, talked much more than usual, or acted impulsively in ways that got you into trouble? Even if it felt productive or positive at the time, has anything like that ever happened?
No, I’ve never experienced anything like that. If anything, I’ve only ever felt the complete opposite—just incredibly low, drained, and unmotivated.
How long have you been feeling this depressed and unable to enjoy things most days? Has it been at least two weeks in a row?
Yes, it has definitely been longer than two weeks. This heavy, unmotivated, and joyless feeling has been constant for about a month now, ever since my last promising contract fell through.

No history of manic/hypomanic episodes and no psychotic symptoms were reported, supporting a severe depressive episode without psychotic symptoms.
